question: Can conservative pin-based legal acceptance remove duplicate make/undo work without changing search?
baseline: same source/configuration with FORKLIFT_REFERENCE_LEGALGEN; old make/undo legality for every pseudo move
candidate: accept only unpinned non-king non-EP non-castling moves outside check; all uncertain cases use baseline
build: MSVC Release, native AVX2 plus IPO, same flags for both uninstrumented binaries
correctness: independent old-generation oracle, ordered complete move metadata and board restoration
castling, both-colour promotions and EP, all pin directions, checks, malformed states, random legal games and artificial boards
all CTests plus focused AddressSanitizer legality test
exact move, score, reached depth, main and qnode counts, other printed search counters in every benchmark

evaluators: verified shared V1 at 100 percent, incremental
measurement.host: no concurrent project workloads during timing
measurement.primaryStatistic: median of seven paired candidate/reference search-time ratios, reported separately for each evaluator
measurement.success: all exactness gates pass and primary NNUE median time reduction >= 2 percent, with at least six of seven pairs faster
measurement.diagnostics: one instrumented run per binary and evaluator, reported separately; timers include overhead and are not speed evidence

limits: fixed-depth local single-thread cost is not Elo
not a proof over every possible board state
